text:
[LGRA.5.9.10] **`tolerance` is admissible only on a `mutable` slot.**
`tolerance` on a `key` slot ([LGRA.5.10], [LFAC.1.7]) is a **compile error**: a
`logical` fact's identity is exact, and a tolerance on an identity slot would
make identity fuzzy and non-transitive (`1.00 ≈ 1.05 ≈ 1.10` yet
`1.00 ≉ 1.10`). `tolerance` is a meaningful-change threshold for *payload*
([LFAC.2.5.1]); identity is exact. (This key-slot rule does not arise on a
`ttl` schema — `tolerance` is rejected there outright per [LGRA.5.9.5].)
